goal: Build and validate a local Power BI PBIP/PBIR dashboard from uploaded CSV data with minimal agent cost and strict branch isolation.
description: The Power BI branch must skip report-oriented research, Python analysis coding, narrative translation, and decision-report stages. It should profile source data, plan a semantic model and dashboard, build and author it with scoped Microsoft tools, validate it through Desktop Bridge, and perform independent screenshot QA.
tasks: Profile uploaded CSV schema, types, quality, and KPI candidates
Plan tables, relationships, measures, DAX, pages, visuals, slicers, and acceptance checks
Build and validate the semantic model with allow-listed Modeling MCP tools
Author and validate scoped PBIR report files
Open, reload, refresh, inspect, and capture every page through Desktop Bridge
Perform independent multimodal QA and route bounded repairs
safety_requirements: No PDF or PowerPoint tools on the Power BI branch
No market research or arbitrary shell tools on the Power BI branch
Modeling MCP is exposed only to the Modeling Agent
No success without Bridge screenshots and vision QA
Structured redacted logs and bounded retries
integration_requirements: Power BI Report Authoring Skill and CLI
